title: ARM-2417 pending-change WIP treatment
prompt:
Review the June 30 estimated margin percentage for project ARM-2417 only.

Use the contractor-accounting MCP for current contract value, posted cost to date, and billings. Read the latest PM ETC submission, commercial log, ARM-2417 owner-email/field-directive support PDF, and the WIP policy. The owner has not executed the $382,000 change, while the supported after-hours cost exposure is $275,000 and is not included in PM ETC. Apply the policy's asymmetric treatment of pending revenue and probable cost.

Reconcile the posted contract, cost and billings; bridge PM ETC to close ETC; then calculate EAC, percent complete, earned revenue and total estimated margin at completion. For `estimated_margin`, use current contract value less EAC; do not substitute recognized margin to date (earned revenue less posted cost). Show the complete calculation chain. Do not modify files or post a journal.

Return only one JSON object in your final response with exactly these keys: `current_contract`, `posted_cost`, `billings`, `pm_etc`, `required_etc_adjustment`, `close_etc`, `eac`, `percent_complete`, `earned_revenue`, `estimated_margin`, `margin_percent`. Use dollar values to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals (for example, return 0.1863 for 18.63%), and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
